BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: To receive a full refund for the experience, you must cancel at least 24 hours before it starts.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: If you cancel the experience less than 24 hours before it starts, the amount paid will not be refunded.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: No changes will be accepted if made less than 24 hours before the experience starts.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: The deadline is based on the local time of the experience location.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: This experience requires good weather. If canceled due to bad weather, you will be offered a different date or a full refund.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: This experience requires a minimum number of travelers. If canceled because the minimum isn't met, you will be offered a different date/experience or a full refund.

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: Para recibir el reembolso íntegro de la experiencia debes cancelarla al menos 24 horas antes de que empiece.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: Si cancelas la experiencia menos de 24 horas antes de que empiece, no se te devolverá el importe abonado.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: No se aceptará ningún cambio que se realice cuando falten menos de 24 horas para empezar la experiencia.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: La hora límite se basa en la hora local del lugar donde se realiza la experiencia.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: Tiene que hacer buen tiempo para que se pueda realizar esta experiencia. Si se cancela por malas condiciones meteorológicas, se te ofrecerá otra fecha o el reembolso total del importe abonado.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: En esta experiencia debe haber un número mínimo de viajeros. Si se cancela porque no se llega a dicho mínimo, se te ofrecerá otra fecha o experiencia o el reembolso total del importe abonado.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_link: Obtén más información sobre las cancelaciones

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: Um eine vollständige Rückerstattung für das Erlebnis zu erhalten, müssen Sie mindestens 24 Stunden vor Beginn stornieren.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: Wenn Sie das Erlebnis weniger als 24 Stunden vor Beginn stornieren, wird der gezahlte Betrag nicht erstattet.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: Änderungen, die weniger als 24 Stunden vor Beginn des Erlebnisses vorgenommen werden, werden nicht akzeptiert.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: Die Frist basiert auf der Ortszeit des Erlebnisortes.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: Dieses Erlebnis erfordert gutes Wetter. Wenn es aufgrund schlechten Wetters abgesagt wird, wird Ihnen ein anderer Termin oder eine vollständige Rückerstattung angeboten.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: Dieses Erlebnis erfordert eine Mindestanzahl von Reisenden. Wenn es abgesagt wird, weil das Minimum nicht erreicht wird, wird Ihnen ein anderer Termin/Erlebnis oder eine vollständige Rückerstattung angeboten.

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: Pour recevoir un remboursement complet de l'expérience, vous devez l'annuler au moins 24 heures avant son commencement.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: Si vous annulez l'expérience moins de 24 heures avant son commencement, le montant payé ne sera pas remboursé.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: Aucun changement ne sera accepté s'il est effectué moins de 24 heures avant le début de l'expérience.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: Le délai est basé sur l'heure locale du lieu de l'expérience.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: Cette expérience nécessite un bon temps. Si elle est annulée en raison du mauvais temps, une autre date ou un remboursement complet vous sera proposé.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: Cette expérience nécessite un nombre minimum de voyageurs. Si elle est annulée parce que le minimum n'est pas atteint, une autre date/expérience ou un remboursement complet vous sera proposé.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_link: En savoir plus sur les annulations

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: 体験の全額返金を受けるには、開始時刻の少なくとも24時間前までにキャンセルする必要があります。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: 体験開始の24時間未満前にキャンセルした場合、支払い金額は返金されません。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: 体験開始の24時間未満前に変更を加えることはできません。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: 締め切り時間は体験場所の現地時間に基づきます。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: この体験には良い天候が必要です。悪天候によりキャンセルされた場合、別の日付または全額返金が提供されます。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: この体験には最低人数の旅行者が必要です。最低人数に達しないためにキャンセルされた場合、別の日付/体験または全額返金が提供されます。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_link: キャンセルについて詳しく知る

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: Para receber um reembolso total pela experiência, deve cancelar pelo menos 24 horas antes do início.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: Se cancelar a experiência a menos de 24 horas do início, o valor pago não será reembolsado.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: Não serão aceites alterações realizadas a menos de 24 horas do início da experiência.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: O prazo é baseado no horário local do local da experiência.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: Esta experiência requer bom tempo. Se for cancelada devido ao mau tempo, será oferecida uma data diferente ou o reembolso total.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: Esta experiência requer um número mínimo de viajantes. Se for cancelada porque não foi atingido o mínimo, será oferecida uma data diferente/experiência ou o reembolso total.

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: Per ricevere un rimborso completo per l'esperienza, devi cancellare almeno 24 ore prima dell'inizio.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: Se cancelli l'esperienza meno di 24 ore prima dell'inizio, l'importo pagato non verrà rimborsato.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: Non saranno accettate modifiche effettuate meno di 24 ore prima dell'inizio dell'esperienza.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: La scadenza è basata sull'ora locale del luogo dell'esperienza.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: Questa esperienza richiede bel tempo. Se cancellata a causa del maltempo, ti verrà offerta una data diversa o un rimborso completo.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: Questa esperienza richiede un numero minimo di viaggiatori. Se cancellata perché il minimo non viene raggiunto, ti verrà offerta una data/esperienza diversa o un rimborso completo.

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: Чтобы получить полный возврат средств за мероприятие, вы должны отменить его как минимум за 24 часа до начала.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: Если вы отменяете мероприятие менее чем за 24 часа до начала, уплаченная сумма не возвращается.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: Изменения, внесенные менее чем за 24 часа до начала мероприятия, не принимаются.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: Срок основан на местном времени места проведения мероприятия.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: Это мероприятие требует хорошей погоды. В случае отмены из-за плохой погоды вам будет предложена другая дата или полный возврат средств.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: Это мероприятие требует минимального количества путешественников. Если оно отменено из-за того, что минимум не достигнут, вам будет предложена другая дата/мероприятие или полный возврат средств.

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: 要获得体验的全额退款，您必须在开始前至少24小时取消。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: 如果您在体验开始前不到24小时取消，已付金额将不予退还。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: 在体验开始前不到24小时进行的更改将不被接受。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: 截止时间基于体验地点的当地时间。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: 此体验需要良好的天气。如果因天气恶劣而取消，将为您提供其他日期或全额退款。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: 此体验需要最少旅行者人数。如果因未达到最低人数而取消，将为您提供其他日期/体验或全额退款。
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_link: 了解更多关于取消的信息

BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_description: 체험에 대한 전액 환불을 받으려면 시작 시간 최소 24시간 전에 취소해야 합니다.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point1: 체험 시작 24시간 미만으로 취소하는 경우 지불한 금액은 환불되지 않습니다.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point2: 체험 시작 24시간 미만으로 변경 사항을 요청할 수 없습니다.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point3: 마감 시간은 체험 장소의 현지 시간을 기준으로 합니다.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point4: 이 체험에는 좋은 날씨가 필요합니다. 악천후로 인해 취소될 경우 다른 날짜 또는 전액 환불이 제공됩니다.
BookingInfo.cancellation_policy_modal_point5: 이 체험에는 최소 인원의 여행자가 필요합니다. 최소 인원에 도달하지 않아 취소될 경우 다른 날짜/체험 또는 전액 환불이 제공됩니다.
